notes: «حدثني أبي» names the compiler's father with no name: relation; «جماعة مشايخي» is an unnamed group of shaykhs
«جميعا» closes three co-transmitters at one level before أحمد بن محمد بن عيسى
The Imam named after «عن» inside the chain stays narrator (owner ruling 2); «قال مروا شيعتنا» is his saying
